hints.title: Hierarchical Subtree Serialization
hints.text: Build a prefix tree of folder hierarchies and compute a canonical serialization string for every node subfolder tree.

hints.title: Post-Order Canonical Representation
hints.text: In post-order fashion, concatenate sorted child folder names and their respective serialized child trees.

hints.title: Pruning Duplicate Subtree Signatures
hints.text: Count serial string frequencies across all nodes; any non-empty subfolder signature with count >= 2 is marked for deletion.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: deg: branching degree of folder nodes
complexity.notes: Subtree canonical serialization and frequency table hashing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing subtrees pairwise takes O(N^2) recursive comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Post-order string serialization enables O(1) expected hashing for identical folder architectures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Merkle tree / subfolder serialization hashing.
